parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma and Jimmy just completed a 1:1 trade (Sheep for Brick). This is bad for me because Jimmy is at 3 VP and Gemma is helping him get closer to a city while she gets to expand. They are clearly working together to shut me out. I should point out that Jimmy is getting exactly what he needs to win.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemma traded 1 Sheep to Jimmy for 1 Brick. Jimmy now has Sheep, Ore, and Wheat, putting him very close to a City (he needs 2 Ore, 3 Wheat total). Gemma now has Brick to build a road/settlement. Both are still actively excluding me from trades.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'מה, את ממש מחלקת לו ניצחון במתנה. כבשה זה בדיוק מה שהיה חסר לג'ימי לעיר, והוא כבר ב-3 נקודות. לא חבל?
